meta.title: Domi Adiwijaya
meta.description: Tansuo Domi Adiwijaya de zuopin ji, jishu renshi, ji chuangxin xiangmu; ta shi yi ming zhuanye de keji yu jiating shiyanshi (homelab) aihao zhe.

hero.blurb: Wo sheji bing jiaofu kekao de xitong. Cong jiating shiyanshi jiegou dao shengchan ji zidonghua, wo jiang fuza de xianzhi zhuanhua wei youya er jianren de jiejue fang'an.

about.lead: Wo yi cujin keji shixian geng you yiyi de gaishan wei dongli, wulun shi zai ke kongzhi de jiating shiyanshi, haishi bangzhu taren jiejue fuzade shijie tiaozhan.
about.p1: Wo shi Domi. Zuo wei yi wei zhongshen keji ren, wo jiang zaoqi de haoqi zhuanhua wei you jilu de shijian, sheji neng jiejue zhongyao shijie wenti de xitong.
about.p2: Wo de jiating shiyanshi shi yi ge zhuanzhu de yanfa huanjing: wo zuo yali ceshi, guyi dapo bing qianghua linian, ranhou jiang jing zhengming jianren de shexiang shengchanhua.
about.p3: Chaochu peizhi yu zidonghua, wo ba suo xue biancheng guifan bing fenxiang, rang taren neng geng kuai yingdui fuza xing. Yiqie daka, shunli yunxing de shunjian jiu shi mubiao.

bullets.1: Jiating shiyanshi yanfa, zhongshi shiji jiejue wenti

innovation.title: Keji chuangxin
innovation.description: Wo pinggu xinxing jishu, sheji youya ke kuorong de jiejue fang'an, yongyu jiejue zhongyao wenti.

homelab.title: Jiating shiyanshi yanfa
homelab.description: Yi ge ke kongzhi de huanjing, zai jieshou shiji jiaotong qian, yonglai yali ceshi, qianghua, bing shengchanhua linian.

automation.title: Zidonghua youxian
automation.description: Renhe chongfu liangci de gongzuo dou ying dang chengwei kekao, dengjia de zidonghua duixiang.

sharing.title: Zhishi fenxiang
sharing.description: Wo jiang suode jingyan jianhua wei wendang, shiyan he yanjiang, jiakuai tuandui xuexi.

skills.lead: Zhe shi wo yilai de gongju lian, yongyu sheji, zidonghua he yunyin xitong; zai fuzai xia reng youya, zai guzhang shi ke yuce.

tail.title: Yong bu ting zhi xuexi
tail.body: Keji riri jingjin. Wo buduan shiyan he yali ceshi xinxing gongju, youhua shijian, bing jiaofu ke lianghua de geng hao jieguo.

services.lead: Cong quanliujing jichu sheshi dao nayi ge jiaonan de linshi renwu, wo dou tigong shiji, jianjiu de jiejue fang'an.

homelab.title: Jiating shiyanshi dajian
homelab.description: Sheji he bushu yige yongyu xuexi, zhantai huozhe zizhuzhuchi de jiating shiyanshi, jichu zai kekao de wangluo, xunihua he cunchu.

cloud.title: Yun shang qianyi
cloud.description: Yi ge jianshi, guanzhu chengben de jihua ji shiyonghua mubiao jiegou, youxiao jiangdi ni yun qianyi de fengxian.

security.title: Anquan shezhi
security.description: Jianli jianshi ke xing de anquan kongzhi, xianshi youxiao jiangdi fengxian, er bu fangman jiaofu sudu.

automation.title: Kekaoxin de zidonghua
automation.description: Yong qiangzhuang, dengjia de zidonghua xiaochu zaowu, rang ni zhuanzhu yu geng you jiazhi de chengguo.

monitoring.title: Jiankong yu tixing
monitoring.description: Huoqu duixitong de kexingdong kanjian he zaoqi xinhao, yuan yuan zaoyu yonghu ganshou yingxiang zhiqian.

data.title: Shuju yu beifen
data.description: Yi jianshi de beifen, kuaisu huifu he yange shengmingzhou guanli baohu guanjian shuju.

tail.title: Xuyao butong de fangan ma?
tail.body: Changjing ge yi, muban changchang nan yi shiyong. Gaosu wo ni de xuqiu, women jiang genju mubiao, xianzhi he shijianbiao sheji heyin de jiejue fang'an.

contact.lead: You xiangmu xuyao guimo dingyi huozhe wenti kongjian dai jiemi ma? Lianxi wo ba; wo qidai liaojie ni de mubiao, bing gouhua yitiao jianshi de qianjin lujing.

drop.title: Gei wo liuyan
drop.body: Shiyong xiafang biaodan huozhe fa youjian, nage geng fangbian jiu xing. Wo hui yuedu meitiao xiaoxi.

form.message_ph: Jianyao miaoshu mubiao, xianzhi he shijianbiao.

connect.title: Lianxi wo
connect.body: Wulun ni zai yanzheng gainian, shengji xitong, haishi xuyao dier yijian, wo dou leyiyu canyu bing tigong qingxi de xiayibu.

error404.p: Ni zhaodao de yemian bu cunzai huozhe yi bei yidong.
